title: UAE's Gargash expects 'prolonged' war, calls for Iran-Gulf security talks
gist: UAE presidential adviser Anwar Gargash expects a prolonged war with Iran of varying tempo and a period of instability inside Iran after Ali Khamenei's death, with the IRGC dominant and successor Mojtaba Khamenei unseen. He calls for Iran-Gulf (not only Iran-US) security talks, concedes the GCC failed to form a unified position unlike 1990, downplays the Saudi rift, and voices optimism on Syria's Sharaa and Lebanon while worrying about Israeli right-wing West Bank policies.
